tg.text: Change the color here! There is a custom block to change the color! Use it to change the color!

tm.text:
To add platforms you need to insert this custom block into the design function!

It goes X Y Z pos then the type

The types are:
Platform
Lava
Spike
Bounce
Trampoline
Water
Slowness
Ice
End

If you add cube at the end it will AUTOMATICALLY convert it into a cube.

to.text: Create moving platforms  by inserting the 2 positions you want the platform to move through and then set the type and after that set the speed!

tq.text:
This block can set the pen color to a number. 
Each input of Red Green Blue should be 0-255 and for transparency keep it from1 to 256

R255 G0 B0 A256 = RED
R0 G255 B0 A256 = Green
R0 G0 B255 A256 = Blue
R255 G255 B0 A256 = Yellow
R200 G80 B0 A256 = Orange
R255 G0 B255 = Purple
